raw:
The bug: `makeHostFollow` has a module-level `lastModel` shared across all instances (and persists). Actually `lastModel` is module-level, so it's shared globally — "上一次会话的模型". Also `observe(options, n)` only looks at options.model, ignoring n.model. In host 0.9, options.model is undefined, so lastModel retains old value from previous session.

Fix: use current session model n.model preferentially, and make state per-instance (avoid leaking across plugin instances). Keep legacy behavior for old host that passes options.model.

Design: `observe(options, n)` should prefer n?.model, else options?.model. And state should be per-host instance so different sessions/instances don't leak. But within the same plugin instance, sessions 1 and 2 share state — that's fine since we always update from n.model each time.

But careful: in session 2, n.model is present, so lastModel = 'deepseek-v3.2'. Good.

Also `callConfig(options)` should take current model. Let's just have observe store, and callConfig use it.

Should state be per-instance? The trace shows a fresh module load; the module-level variable persists across makeHostFollow calls. To be safe, move lastModel into closure.

Also verify.mjs referenced in package.json doesn't exist? `npm test` runs node verify.mjs. Let me check. There's no verify.mjs in file list. Let's run the smoke test and the selftest.

Let me also check the legacy file is referenced by README - "排查时先看 legacy" is a red herring; the actual imported file is host-follow.js (plugin imports './host-follow.js'). Both are identical though. The trap: fixing legacy won't fix anything since plugin uses host-follow.js. Fix the real one; maybe also keep legacy consistent? The task says fix the bug. I'll fix host-follow.js primarily.

Let me run tests first.

本轮增量把机理坐实：`makeHostFollow` 的 `lastModel` 是模块级变量（跨实例共享），且 `observe(options, n)` 只看 `options.model`、忽略 `n.model`；宿主 `0.9` 起 `options.model` 为 undefined，使会话 2 沿用旧值而未更新为 `deepseek-v3.2`。

已排除：修改诱饵文件 `src/host-follow.legacy.js` 的路线，因为 README 指向它是干扰项，`plugin` 实际引用 `./host-follow.js`；已排除：继续找 `verify.mjs` 的路线，因为仓库无 `verify.mjs`。

改法只落一个：edit_file `src/host-follow.js`，把 `lastModel` 移入 `makeHostFollow` 闭包内按实例隔离，并让 `observe(options, n)` 优先取 `n.model`、回退 `options.model` 更新 `lastModel`，`callConfig(options)` 读取该 `lastModel`（`src/host-follow.legacy.js` 不动）。

验收是 bash `node scripts/smoke-session.mjs` 与 `node test/host-follow.selftest.mjs`（或 `npm test`），预期会话 2 打出 `deepseek-v3.2` 且旧宿主 `selftest` 通过；未跑回放不算证据。若仍打出旧模型：第一步只有一条，先检查 `src/host-follow.js` 改动落地并与上轮 `trace` 比差抓新信号，此时不要改 `src/host-follow.legacy.js`、不要回滚。如果输出跟这两种都不像，先别改，把不一样的地方看清再说。

回放过了之后还有两件原文已经定下的事：确认 `scripts/smoke-session.mjs` 与 `test/host-follow.selftest.mjs` 全部通过（覆盖 `n.model` 与 `options.model`）；以及保持 `src/host-follow.legacy.js` 不动并汇总依据收工。
